connection.SHVnZ2luZ0ZhY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source:
A connection to the Hugging Face REST API.

Requires an API key (set as `apikey`) from [Hugging Face Settings](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens). The connection uses the `huggingface://` URL scheme and provides access to the Hub API for models, datasets, and spaces
connection.SHVnZ2luZ0ZhY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message:
Spojenie s REST API Hugging Face.

Vyžaduje kľúč API (nastavený ako `apikey`) z [Nastavenia Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens). Spojeenie používa schému URL `huggingface://` a poskytuje prístup k Hub API pre modely, súbory dát a priestory

connection.SHVnZ2luZ0ZhY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: The API base path to use

The Hugging Face API token used for authentication; sent as the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

Get your token from [Hugging Face Settings](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens)
